fields.help: Explicit model path relative to /models. Leave blank for flat files (llama-server resolves section-name.gguf automatically). Required for sharded models: point at the first shard, e.g. MyModel-Q4_K_M/MyModel-Q4_K_M-00001-of-00003.gguf.
fields.label: Model file (relative to /models)

fields.help: Prompt context length in tokens. 0 = load from model metadata. Larger uses more VRAM for KV cache.
fields.label: Context size

fields.help: Number of layers offloaded to VRAM. 999 or 'all' forces every layer; lower values push work to CPU.
fields.label: GPU layers

fields.help: Fused attention kernel that reduces KV cache memory and speeds prompt processing. 'auto' probes support at load.
fields.label: Flash attention

fields.help: Data type for the K side of the KV cache. q8_0 is a strong VRAM saver with minimal quality loss. f16 = default.
fields.label: KV cache — K quant

fields.help: Data type for the V side of the KV cache. Keep this equal to K. Going below q8_0 saves VRAM but can silently fall off the CUDA flash-attention fast path and run attention on the CPU — measured 15x slower prompt eval (1737 -> 115 tok/s) on a 27B with a 256-wide head dim. The fallback is invisible on short prompts, so if you change this, benchmark a LONG one and watch GPU utilization.
fields.label: KV cache — V quant

fields.help: Number of concurrent generation slots the server hosts. -1 = auto. Each slot needs its own KV allocation.
fields.label: Parallel slots (--np)

fields.help: Use the model's built-in Jinja chat template (from tokenizer.chat_template). Needed for many modern chat models.
fields.label: Enable --jinja templating

fields.help: Override the chat template. Accepts a built-in name (llama3, chatml, gemma, etc.) or an inline Jinja string.
fields.label: Chat template

fields.help: Logical maximum batch size for prompt processing. Higher = faster prompt eval but more scratch memory.
fields.label: Batch size (logical)

fields.help: Physical batch size the backend actually dispatches. Lower it if OOM during prompt processing.
fields.label: Ubatch size (physical)

fields.help: On context-shift, how many tokens from the very start of the prompt to preserve. -1 = keep all (no shifting).
fields.label: Tokens to keep from prompt

fields.help: Use full-size cache for sliding-window attention models (Gemma, Mistral SWA variants). Higher VRAM, avoids some artifacts.
fields.label: Full-size SWA cache

fields.help: How to split a model across multiple GPUs. none = single GPU, layer = pipeline-split (default), row = per-row parallel, tensor = experimental.
fields.label: Multi-GPU split mode

fields.help: Which GPU holds the model when split-mode=none, or which GPU holds intermediates/KV when split-mode=row.
fields.label: Main GPU index

fields.help: Comma-separated proportions of the model to place on each GPU. '3,1' = 75% on GPU0, 25% on GPU1.
fields.label: Tensor split ratio

fields.help: mmap = default memory-map, mlock = lock in RAM (no swap), mmap+mlock = both, dio = direct I/O when supported.
fields.label: Model load mode

fields.help: Enable NUMA hints for multi-socket boxes. distribute = spread threads, isolate = stay on one node, numactl = use provided map.
fields.label: NUMA optimizations

fields.help: Comma-separated devices to use for offloading. 'none' disables offload. Use --list-devices at CLI to enumerate.
fields.label: Device list

fields.help: When on (default), llama-server auto-tunes any unset args to fit the model in device memory.
fields.label: Auto-fit VRAM

fields.help: Reserved headroom per device for --fit. Single value broadcasts to all devices; comma list assigns per-device. Default 1024.
fields.label: Fit target margin (MiB per device)

fields.help: The smallest ctx-size --fit is allowed to fall back to. Prevents fit from shrinking your context below this.
fields.label: Fit minimum ctx

fields.help: Whether KV cache lives on the GPU. Default on. Disable to save VRAM at the cost of a lot of PCIe traffic.
fields.label: KV cache offload to GPU

fields.help: Repack weights for faster on-device access. Default on. Rarely worth disabling.
fields.label: Weight repacking

fields.help: Offload host-side tensor operations to the device. Default on.
fields.label: Host operation offload

fields.help: Skip the host staging buffer, allowing extra device buffers to be used. Advanced.
fields.label: Bypass host buffer (--no-host)

fields.help: Scan tensor data for invalid values at load. Diagnostic use; slows load significantly.
fields.label: Check tensor data at load

fields.help: Interleave prompt+generation across slots. Default on. Off = one request at a time.
fields.label: Continuous batching

fields.help: On overflow, shift out oldest tokens (keeping --keep from the start) to make room. Default on for endless-chat use.
fields.label: Context shift

fields.help: Reuse KV cache from a previous request when the new prompt shares a prefix. Set to 1 to enable — huge TTFT win for chat continuations (only new tokens are prompt-evaluated). 0 disables. Free, safe, should almost always be on.
fields.label: Prefix cache reuse (min tokens)

fields.help: Share one KV cache across all slots (saves memory) vs. per-slot caches (better cache locality).
fields.label: Unified KV cache

fields.help: Server-side RAM budget for prefix / prompt caches. 0 = disable. Saved values are capped at the hard maximum (LLAMACPP_CACHE_RAM_HARD_MAX_MIB, default 2048); -1 (unlimited) is stored as that maximum.
fields.label: Cache RAM budget (MiB)

fields.help: How many rolling context checkpoints to retain. More = faster context restoration on branching, more memory.
fields.label: SWA / ctx checkpoints

fields.help: Minimum token spacing between checkpoints. Default 8192.
fields.label: Checkpoint min step

fields.help: Run a tiny inference at startup to force lazy init. Default on. Off saves ~1s at boot.
fields.label: Warmup run at startup

fields.help: Force certain tensors onto a specific buffer/device. Advanced: e.g. 'blk\.\d+\.ffn_.*=CPU'.
fields.label: Override tensor buffer

fields.help: Force a metadata key at load time. Types: int/float/bool/str. Example: 'tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token=bool:false'.
fields.label: Override GGUF metadata

fields.help: How to extend context beyond the trained length. yarn = the modern choice for most long-context models.
fields.label: RoPE scaling method

fields.help: Multiplier that expands context by factor N. Example: 4.0 with a 32K-native model gives 128K context.
fields.label: RoPE context scale

fields.help: RoPE base frequency (theta). Loaded from model unless overridden. Higher values push effective context out.
fields.label: RoPE base frequency

fields.help: Alternate way to expand context: multiplies by 1/N. rope-scale = 4 is equivalent to rope-freq-scale = 0.25.
fields.label: RoPE freq scale

fields.help: Model's native training context length. YaRN uses this to compute the extrapolation ratio.
fields.label: YaRN original ctx

fields.help: Mix between interpolation and extrapolation. 0 = pure interpolation (safest quality), 1 = pure extrapolation.
fields.label: YaRN extrapolation factor

fields.help: Scale factor for √(t) attention magnitude. Default -1 = library default.
fields.label: YaRN attention factor

fields.help: High-frequency correction dim. Default -1 = library default.
fields.label: YaRN β slow (alpha)

fields.help: Low-frequency correction dim. Default -1 = library default.
fields.label: YaRN β fast (beta)

fields.help: For Mixture-of-Experts models: keep every expert on CPU. Big VRAM saver at the cost of PCIe/RAM bandwidth per token.
fields.label: Keep ALL MoE weights on CPU

fields.help: Partial variant: only push the first N layers' experts to CPU. Tune to fit exactly in VRAM.
fields.label: Keep first N layers' MoE on CPU

fields.help: Path to the vision/audio projector GGUF that pairs with a multimodal model. Required for image/audio input.
fields.label: Multimodal projector file

fields.help: Alternative to mmproj: download the projector at startup from a URL.
fields.label: Multimodal projector URL

fields.help: Automatically fetch a matching mmproj when the model repo publishes one.
fields.label: Auto-download mmproj

fields.help: Run the projector on GPU. Default on when a GPU is present.
fields.label: GPU-offload mmproj

fields.help: Minimum tokens each image is allowed to consume in the prompt context (vision models only).
fields.label: Image min tokens

fields.help: Maximum tokens each image is allowed to consume. Tuning knob for latency vs quality on vision.
fields.label: Image max tokens

fields.help: Max image tokens per image-encoding batch. Lower if the projector OOMs; higher for throughput.
fields.label: Multimodal batch max tokens

fields.help: Strategy. draft-* runs a small model to propose tokens (draft-mtp for a head shipped with the weights, draft-simple for a separate GGUF sharing the tokenizer). ngram-* needs no model at all and replays literal repeats from the prompt. llama.cpp accepts a comma-separated list, so 'draft-mtp,ngram-simple' runs both. Autoconfig sets this from the workload profile.
fields.label: Speculative decoding type

fields.help: Local path to a small 'draft' GGUF used to propose tokens the main model verifies. For Qwen3 with MTP, use the model's official MTP draft head.
fields.label: Draft model path

fields.help: Hugging Face repo to pull the draft model from (llama-server auto-downloads at startup).
fields.label: Draft HF repo

fields.help: How many draft-model layers to place on GPU; 999 offloads everything. Leave this high: a draft evaluated on the CPU is slower than the GPU model it is supposed to be racing ahead of, which defeats the entire mechanism.
fields.label: Draft GPU layers

fields.help: Comma-separated devices for the draft model. Often the same as main; sometimes a spare GPU.
fields.label: Draft device list

fields.help: How deep to guess: max draft tokens per attempt (llama.cpp default 3). Multiplies the win on predictable text and the waste on unpredictable text — 8 for code, 2 for prose. Draft models only; ngram-* strategies take their length from spec-ngram-*-size-m instead.
fields.label: Draft n_max

fields.help: Floor on draft length — always attempt at least this many (default 0).
fields.label: Draft n_min

fields.help: How sure the drafter must be before it bothers (default 0.00 = always try). Raise it to decline the marginal bets when acceptance is poor; lower it when the text is predictable enough that even mediocre guesses land.
fields.label: Draft p_min

fields.help: Probability at which speculation branches into a draft tree rather than a single line (default 0.10).
fields.label: Draft p_split

fields.help: For MoE draft models: keep experts on CPU.
fields.label: Draft: all MoE on CPU

fields.help: Partial CPU offload for the draft's MoE layers.
fields.label: Draft: N MoE layers on CPU

fields.help: KV K quant for the draft model. Can differ from the main model's.
fields.label: Draft KV cache K

fields.help: KV V quant for the draft model.
fields.label: Draft KV cache V

fields.help: For ngram lookup decoding: path to a read-only n-gram store built from a corpus.
fields.label: Static lookup cache (path)

fields.help: Writable n-gram cache the server updates as it serves. Persists to disk between restarts.
fields.label: Dynamic lookup cache (path)

fields.help: Path(s) to LoRA adapter GGUF files applied at load. Comma-separated for multiple.
fields.label: LoRA adapter(s)

fields.help: LoRA adapters with per-adapter scale factors. Useful for blending styles.
fields.label: LoRA scaled adapters

fields.help: Path(s) to control-vector files that steer generation. Comma-separated for multiple.
fields.label: Control vector(s)

fields.help: Control vectors with per-vector scale factors.
fields.label: Control vector scaled

fields.help: Restrict where control vectors apply. Two integers, e.g. '10 30' for layers 10 through 30 inclusive.
fields.label: Control vector layer range

fields.help: CPU threads used during single-token generation. Usually = physical cores. -1 auto-picks.
fields.label: Threads (generation)

fields.help: Threads used during batched prompt processing. Higher can help prompt eval on many-core CPUs.
fields.label: Threads (batch/prompt)

fields.help: Bitmask of CPU cores to pin threads to, arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range.
fields.label: CPU affinity mask (hex)

fields.help: Range of CPU indices for affinity, e.g. '0-15'.
fields.label: CPU range lo-hi

fields.help: Force threads to stay on the mask/range. Off = kernel may migrate.
fields.label: Strict CPU placement

fields.help: Scheduling priority: -1 low, 0 normal (default), 1 medium, 2 high, 3 realtime.
fields.label: Process priority

fields.help: How aggressively worker threads busy-wait for work. Higher = lower latency, more idle CPU.
fields.label: Polling level (0-100)

fields.help: Whether the model uses its reasoning (thinking) mode. 'auto' = detected from the chat template (the right default for most reasoning models). Force 'on' to always think, 'off' to skip thinking for lower latency.
fields.label: Enable reasoning / thinking

fields.help: How thoughts appear in responses. 'deepseek' = thoughts in message.reasoning_content (OpenAI-compatible clients like OpenWebUI hide them). 'deepseek-legacy' = keeps <think> tags in content too. 'none' = raw, unparsed. Default: auto.
fields.label: Reasoning output format

fields.help: Max tokens the model can spend on reasoning per response. -1 = unlimited (default), 0 = skip thinking entirely, N>0 = hard cap. Rough map to OpenAI 'reasoning_effort': low ≈ 512, medium ≈ 2048, high ≈ 8192 or -1.
fields.label: Reasoning token budget
fields.placeholder: -1 unrestricted · 0 = skip thinking · N = hard cap

fields.help: Message injected right before the end-of-thinking tag when the budget runs out. Nudges the model to wrap up.
fields.label: Reasoning-budget cutoff message

fields.help: Keep the full thinking trace in the conversation history, not just the last turn. Needed for templates with 'supports_preserve_reasoning'. Uses more context per turn.
fields.label: Preserve reasoning across turns

fields.help: Server-facing model name. Defaults to the section name; only override if you need a different API-visible id.
fields.label: Alias override

fields.help: Informational tags surfaced in /v1/models. Not used for routing — cosmetic.
fields.label: Tags (comma-separated)

fields.help: Restrict this slot to embedding requests. Use with dedicated embedding models.
fields.label: Embedding-only mode

fields.help: Enable the /rerank endpoint. Use with dedicated cross-encoder / rerank models.
fields.label: Rerank-only mode

fields.help: Pooling strategy over token embeddings. Model default if unspecified.
fields.label: Embedding pooling

fields.help: L-norm for output embeddings. -1 = none, 0 = max-abs, 1 = taxicab, 2 = Euclidean (default).
fields.label: Embedding normalize

fields.help: Read a Jinja chat template from a file. Useful for external template management.
fields.label: Chat template file (path)

fields.help: Extra variables passed to the Jinja template. JSON object, e.g. '{"enable_thinking": true}'.
fields.label: Chat template kwargs (JSON)

fields.help: Include model-defined special tokens in output. Off by default; on for debugging tokenization.
fields.label: Emit special tokens

fields.help: Move sampling into the backend for speed. Experimental — may interact oddly with some sampler combos.
fields.label: Backend sampling (experimental)

fields.help: 0 generic, 1 error, 2 warn, 3 info (default), 4 trace, 5 debug. Higher = noisier logs.
fields.label: Log verbosity (0-5)
